input.summary: V05 Nilagiri Phytolabs LLP (Prakash), quote received for RFx KPC-2026-014. Quoted: Glycerin 118/kg; Rosemary extract 20% rosmarinic 7000/kg, MOQ 100 kg, 12-month shelf life; Caffeine 1650/kg only if one full lot (size unstated). Freight extra ~Rs 9/kg. Terms: 50% advance, 49% on delivery; delivery 3 weeks. Claims 99% OTIF and zero rejection (no data). Certificates under renewal, COA only after order (conflicts with our need for COA before award). Open: RM-002 MOQ and shelf life; RM-005 MOQ in kg and shelf life. Knockouts H1 (SDS), B5 (COA), H2 (cosmetic suitability) asked now. Also asking OTIF, rejection, need-by date, Incoterm, and rejection/delivery records. No escalations yet.

input.subject: RFx KPC-2026-014: Clarifications needed on your quote
input.body:
Dear Prakash,

Thank you for your quotation for RFx KPC-2026-014. We are reviewing it and need the following before we can progress.

Quote clarifications:
1. Glycerin (RM-002): state the minimum order quantity in kg and the order multiple.
2. Glycerin (RM-002): state the total shelf life from date of manufacture, and the minimum remaining shelf life you guarantee at delivery.
3. Caffeine anhydrous (RM-005): state the lot size in kg that "one full lot" refers to.
4. Caffeine anhydrous (RM-005): state the total shelf life from date of manufacture, and the minimum remaining shelf life you guarantee at delivery.
5. Freight: state the Incoterm and delivery point. Is freight included in the quoted price? If not, confirm the freight amount per kg and whether insurance and packing are included.
6. Need-by date: can you meet a first delivery by 20 December 2026? If not, state your earliest date.

Compliance and quality documents (required for all quoted lines: Glycerin, Rosemary leaf extract, Caffeine anhydrous):
7. Provide the current Safety Data Sheet for each line, including transport hazard class.
8. Provide a Certificate of Analysis from a recent batch for each line, showing batch number, manufacturing date and expiry or retest date. We understand your certificates are under renewal; please send the COA now, not after order.
9. Confirm that each material is suitable for leave-on scalp cosmetic use and permitted under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

Performance:
10. State your on-time-in-full rate for these lines over the last 12 months, with your definition of on-time.
11. State your rejection rate for these lines over the last 12 months, with the period and basis used.
12. Are you willing to share your rejection and delivery records, or a summary of them? This will help us verify the performance figures you have given.

Please reply by 14 November 2026.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
